5r49: Students who dream of starting their own business, teaching business in a University setting, or rising through the ranks of a successful corporation, then business is exactly the academic foundation they need. As a broad discipline, this degree will give students a firm foundation in economics, accounting, financial management, marketing, organizational leadership, ethics, and more. Students will be prepared to pursue a career in the public, private, or governmental sectors, or continue on to a specialized field through further education.
77ny:
Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science has a rich curriculum that prepares students for a wide range of technical roles and includes résumé-ready skills such as:

  • Python programming and the Django framework
  • Debugging errors in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Building solutions to real-world problems with clear, well-written code

This program includes online courses as part of the curriculum through the school's partnership with Rize Education. These classes offer students a cutting-edge curriculum, greater scheduling flexibility, and access to nationwide experts in the field.
5r4b: Studying finance will introduce students to the ways that organizations and corporations make monetary decisions in order to maximize value for their shareholders. This critical function for all for-profit, nonprofit, and government industries requires individuals who think critically, listen carefully, and effectively analyze challenging situations. Students will be prepared for a career in this fast-paced world, ready to apply the appropriate calculations to real-life finance problems at the personal and organizational levels.
5r6r: Focus on managing processes and systems and leading people by studying business management. Managers help companies and organizations reach their goals by focusing on efficiency and effectiveness while also understanding how to work with and lead individuals who focus on many aspects of business operations. Graduate ready for a leadership position in an established company—or ready to run students' own small business.
5rac:
The North Park University’s strong liberal arts tradition reinforces communication, ethical reasoning, and idea synthesizing—skills required of engineers. Often overlooked at purely technical schools, mechanical engineers who also have these soft skills are more prepared to fill a crucial gap in the labor market and will be better prepared to enter the workforce immediately upon graduation.

As an urban university rooted in faith, students pursue their learning in a world-class city with internships at leading engineering firms, all with a sense of purpose.
